description: This file defines the 'Unit' result class for a database schema using DBIx::Class in Perl. It specifies the table 'units', its columns, primary key, relationships to other tables (such as conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, items), and includes methods for retrieving related units and conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Unit
classes.description: A class representing the 'units' table in the database, with relationships to conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items, and methods for related unit retrieval.

methods.name: convertible_into
methods.description: Returns all units that the current unit can be converted into, based on the 'conversions' relationship.

methods.name: find_conversion_into
methods.description: Finds a specific conversion record into another unit identified by unit_id.
